item.title: A magnitude 5.7 earthquake strikes central Japan with its epicenter in Shizuoka Prefecture, while also primarily affecting Aichi, Gifu, Nagano and Yamanashi Prefectures.
item.description:
A magnitude 5.7 earthquake strikes central Japan with its epicenter in Shizuoka Prefecture, while also primarily affecting Aichi, Gifu, Nagano and Yamanashi Prefectures. 22 people are injured.

Sources: AP, NHK World

item.title: New Zealanders vote to elect 120 members of the House of Representatives, with 11 additional overhang seats.
item.description:
New Zealanders vote to elect 120 members of the House of Representatives, with 11 additional overhang seats. National leader Christopher Luxon and Labour leader Chris Hipkins both seek reappointment as the country's prime minister. Preliminary results see Labour lead in the popular vote and the Nationals having the most amount of seats, with special votes yet to be counted.

Sources: AP, RNZ

Topics: 2026 New Zealand general election

item.title: Au Kam San, a former pro-democracy legislator of Macau, is convicted in a closed-door trial of "subversion against the political power of the state" and sentenced to 12 years and 6 months in prison.
item.description:
Au Kam San, a former pro-democracy legislator of Macau, is convicted in a closed-door trial of "subversion against the political power of the state" and sentenced to 12 years and 6 months in prison. It is the first conviction under the Macau National Security Law, which was revised by lawmakers in 2023 to broaden its scope and to allow for closed-door trials.

Sources: BBC News

item.title: Vice President Pedro Alliana is sworn in as the interim president of Paraguay. / The Public Prosecutor's Office orders the arrest of Santiago Peña, who is placed under house arrest. / The Paraguayan Senate unanimously removes Santiago Peña as country's president over alleged conflicts of interest involving Ueno Bank, whose accounts the central bank froze.
item.description:
Vice President Pedro Alliana is sworn in as the interim president of Paraguay.

Sources: Reuters

The Public Prosecutor's Office orders the arrest of Santiago Peña, who is placed under house arrest.

Sources: UPI

The Paraguayan Senate unanimously removes Santiago Peña as country's president over alleged conflicts of interest involving Ueno Bank, whose accounts the central bank froze. Congress postpones consideration of Peña's resignation to allow impeachment proceedings.

Sources: AFP, Reuters
